title: Black Friday 2026 in Australia: How to Budget for It With AI
excerpt: Black Friday 2026 in Australia is Friday 27 November. Here's how to get your real spending numbers and let ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude build your Christmas budget first.
seoTitle: Black Friday 2026 Australia: Budget for It With AI

faq.q: When is Black Friday in Australia in 2026?
faq.a: Black Friday 2026 is Friday 27 November, and Cyber Monday is Monday 30 November. Many Australian retailers run their sales across the whole week, so it pays to have your list and budget sorted before then.

faq.q: How do I make a Christmas budget with ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude?
faq.a: Get your actual spending totals by category first, then paste a prompt that asks the AI to interview you one question at a time. Once it has your numbers, it can build the budget, a per-person gift limit and a tracker. Always check its maths.

faq.q: Is it safe to upload my bank statements to AI?
faq.a: It's best not to upload raw statements. The Office of the Australian Information Commissioner advises against entering personal and sensitive information into AI tools, so crop out names and account numbers, or share category totals instead.

faq.q: What budgeting app can I use in Australia to track my spending?
faq.a: Many Australian banking apps already group your spending by category. Dedicated budgeting apps like PocketSmith connect to your bank accounts and track where your money goes. Either gives you the actual numbers an AI budget needs.

faq.q: How do I stop overspending in the Black Friday sales?
faq.a: Set one dollar cap for the whole sales period, only buy what was already on your list, and wait 24 hours before buying anything that wasn't. Log each purchase the same day.

title: How to Build a Website With AI (No Code, Under $100)
excerpt: Here's exactly how to use Claude, Squarespace, or Lovable to build your site without code, in natural language, for less than $100 total.
seoTitle: Lovable AI vs Squarespace vs Claude: Build a Website With AI
metaDescription: How to build a website with AI for under $100: Lovable AI, Squarespace, Durable and Claude compared on cost, build time and control. No code needed.

faq.q: How much does it cost to build a website with AI?
faq.a: Using the three paths in this guide: the easy path (Durable or Squarespace) costs about $20 a month, the medium path (Lovable or Wix) about $50 a month, and the advanced path (Claude, GitHub and Netlify) about $32 a month, or roughly $384 in year one. Hiring someone on Airtasker for a simple site typically costs $500 to $2,000.

faq.q: Do I need to know how to code to build a website with AI?
faq.a: No. All three paths use natural language: you describe the site in plain English and the AI tool builds it. The advanced path involves learning basic Git so you can push changes to GitHub, but you don't write the code yourself.

faq.q: How long does it take to build a website with AI?
faq.a: Durable can generate a working site in about 2 minutes. Lovable typically takes 1 to 2 hours for a custom design, and the Claude, GitHub and Netlify path takes 2 to 4 hours.

faq.q: What is Lovable AI?
faq.a: Lovable is an AI website builder that reads your plain-English description and generates the actual code for your site. In this guide it's the medium path, at about $50 a month on the pro plan, with more design control than template builders.

faq.q: Which AI website builder should I choose?
faq.a: Choose Durable or Squarespace if you want to be live today with professional templates. Choose Lovable or Wix if you need design control or want to sell products. Choose Claude with GitHub and Netlify if you want to own your code, build complex features and avoid vendor lock-in.

faq.q: Was appcoaching.io built with AI?
faq.a: Yes. appcoaching.io was built with Claude and deploys through GitHub and Netlify, the advanced path described in this guide.

title: Finance Coaching: Why Smart People Struggle With Money
excerpt: Accountants can't track their own finances. If confusion this widespread is normal at the top, what does that say about the rest of us?
seoTitle: Financial Coaching: Why Smart People Struggle With Money
metaDescription: What does a financial coach do? A Brisbane Chartered Accountant on why smart people struggle with money, and how financial coaching builds financial literacy.

faq.q: What does a financial coach do?
faq.a: A financial coach works one-on-one with you to help you understand your own numbers: where your money actually goes, how to prioritise debt, savings and investing, and how compound growth plays out over time. The goal is to make decisions from clarity instead of guessing.

faq.q: Why do smart people struggle with money?
faq.a: It isn't about intelligence. Most people were never shown a framework for their own finances. Even accountants often don't track their personal cash flow, and many business owners can't clearly read their own profit and loss statement.

faq.q: Is finance coaching the same as financial advice?
faq.a: No. Finance coaching is education: it helps you understand your numbers and build better habits. It doesn't recommend specific financial products such as shares, super funds or loans. In Australia, that kind of personal advice must come from a licensed financial adviser.

faq.q: Do you offer finance coaching in Brisbane?
faq.a: Yes. I'm a Brisbane-based Chartered Accountant, and I coach clients in Brisbane and online across Queensland and the rest of Australia. You can book a free 15-minute discovery call to see whether coaching is the right fit.

title: Why I Chose Accounting: The Journey from Rule-Follower to Translator
excerpt: From my mum's exactness to PwC's pressure to Coronis—how accounting taught me the real value isn't processing numbers, it's making them make sense.
seoTitle: Is Accounting a Good Career? From PwC Grad to Translator
metaDescription: Is accounting a good career? A Chartered Accountant on the PwC graduate program, Flight Centre, and what accountants really do once the books balance.

faq.q: Is accounting a good career?
faq.a: For people who like order and logic, yes. Accounting suits people who like order and logic: the books either balance or they don't. Over a career, the most valuable skill becomes translating numbers into clear decisions for other people.

faq.q: What is the PwC graduate program like in audit?
faq.a: Audit is time-poor and high-pressure: you gather evidence and review workpapers at speed, with accuracy non-negotiable. It's a fast way to learn efficient habits, especially in Excel.

faq.q: What do accountants actually do?
faq.a: Day to day, accountants record transactions, reconcile accounts and prepare financial statements, forecasts and analysis. The most valuable part is translating what those numbers mean so decision-makers can act on them.

faq.q: What skills matter most for accountants today?
faq.a: Efficient Excel and AI skills save time, but the skill that moves the needle is explaining what the numbers mean in plain language so leaders can act on them.

faq.q: Do you offer career coaching for young finance professionals?
faq.a: Yes. APP Coaching offers career coaching for graduates and young accountants and analysts, in Brisbane and online across Australia.
